metrics.design: same FPV camera every 40 ms, same neural ticks, same decision-frame RAFT/depth compute, same readout and quad stabilizer
metrics.retina_limit: 1D luminance projection from middle half of image; azimuth estimates only, no elevation or measured photoreceptor tuning

inputs.retina: tag angle + timed FPV luminance -> photoreceptors

metrics.readout: same bearing-trained DNa02 linear readout in all conditions

open_loop_controls.retina_static: last frame repeated with the same frame count
open_loop_controls.retina_reverse: same frames in reverse temporal order
open_loop_controls.retina_only: LC10a input omitted; output gain still uses tag angle
